question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

DURDG : EFJVZ :: JGFSGR : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbc5c097aeb98a48b72ad50b9d4e29b952906e3f76fa5d128ba82d4b9289f2b.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

DURDG : EFJVZ

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd4f704ad6dde1d8c4c8d5e6c23183fe7b4edb560b701e3808a9a4958b498aed.png] 

Similarly,

JGFSGR : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/550a03b9a61311940fbae3d861b71646770251398783834c7f1a2bd016ac46f5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"GIJNWY".**
